deals.title: Happy Hour
deals.summary: Happy hour appetizers like smoked wings, burgers, quesadillas, fry towers, plus a Food + Draft special
deals.evidence: Our happy hour menu will delight you with delectable appetizers such as smoked wings, burgers, quesadillas, fry towers and more. The Food + Draft special is sure to be your new go-to. Happy Hour is daily from 4 to 7 p.m.

notes: Happy hour applies daily at both locations, including Dallas (Greenville Ave). No prices given; happy hour menu details appear to be in a linked menu not included. Daily specials are only posted on social media.
